pages.title: Quinkana
pages.text: $(o)Quinkana$() ($(o)Quinkana fortirostrum$()) was a land-hunting crocodile of Pleistocene Australia.$(br2)It had longer legs held under its body and a deep snout lined with blade-like teeth, built for hunting on land rather than in the water.$(br2)It disappeared around 40,000 years ago.
